mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for a full kitchen cabinet installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The typical process for a full kitchen cabinet installation begins with site preparation, ensuring the area is clear and level. Next, base cabinets are installed first, carefully leveled and secured, followed by wall cabinets. Adjustments are made to ensure doors and drawers operate smoothly and are perfectly aligned. Finally, trim, molding, and hardware are added to complete the installation. Our process includes a final walkthrough with you to ensure satisfaction and address any questions.
acceptedAnswer.description: Full kitchen cabinet installation involves site prep, installing base then wall cabinets, adjusting doors and drawers, and adding trim and hardware, followed by a final walkthrough.
